design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (round 7).
DRAW (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[4,5,4]: cancellation date 5, insured increase charge 4, cancellation credit and refund 4.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller wants back the federal premium for the period his Tidemark HomeFlood renters plan covers. The refund (root, booked with the cancellation) waits on the insured's own signed request stating the date, and on the billing of a contents increase he asked for in July that the desk never put into effect. The date is the replacing HomeFlood policy's effective date, and none of the backdating, lead, paid-up or breadth limits moves it to the signing date (cross-difficulty reads of the HomeFlood policy and its ledger); the increase takes effect the day after its premium arrived because the apartment was newly mapped into a Special Flood Hazard Area within 13 months (federal map-revision exception; neither the premium limit nor the quote limit moves it to the standard dating) and its rise is measured on the basis it was rated on; the replacement took effect 2026-06-20, before the current term began on 2026-07-15, so the expired term is earned, the current term never ran and is returned whole, and the increase and the certificate re-rate, both effective after the cancellation date, are unwound in full.
SCOPE: task 1 claims dwelling_ext_replacement_cancellation_date, dwelling_ext_insured_increase_charge, dwelling_ext_replacement_cancellation_credit and tools sign_cancellation_request_cbba569e, bill_insured_increase_9da169e7, process_policy_cancellation_6794673f; task 0 claims the other four policies and tools.
PROBLEM TREE: root dwelling_ext_replacement_cancellation_credit <- dwelling_ext_replacement_cancellation_date (value_input, gate cancel_date, state) and <- dwelling_ext_insured_increase_charge (value_input, gate endo_risk, state). The two prerequisites are independent; gold order sign (9), bill (11), process (13).
FACTORS: date ['anchor_rule', 'backdate_window_rule', 'lead_window_rule', 'paid_up_window_rule', 'breadth_rule']; increase ['waiting_days_rule', 'premium_window_rule', 'quote_window_rule', 'rise_basis_rule']; credit ['refund_method_rule', 'endorsement_fraction_rule', 'rerate_fraction_rule', 'lines_rule']. Baselines: date 2026-10-13, increase 90.41, refund 639.81 (the PRO_RATA term share 390/365 applied as booked).
GOLD: requested_effective_date 2026-06-20; risk_premium_charge 44.26 (reserve fund 7.97, effective 2026-07-21, endorsed 476.00); refund_amount 598.79 (risk 486.26, reserve fund 87.53, HFIAA 25.00, ICC 0.00) to INSURED.
NEAR-MISSES: the signing date 2026-10-13 (standard reading), the standard 30-day dating (2026-08-19), the rise measured from the certified figure 431.00, the PRO_RATA share 390/365 applied to the current term, the expired term's last 25 days refunded, the increase pro rated instead of unwound, the Federal Policy Fee returned.
user_scenario: You are Dominic Boudreaux, a line cook in Kenner who rents an apartment and keeps things short and practical. In June you bought Tidemark's HomeFlood renters plan for your apartment, and it has covered your belongings since June 20. You are calling because you also still have the federal flood policy on the same apartment, and you want the money you paid for the federal flood policy back for the time since the HomeFlood plan started. You want whatever is due paid back to you and you are fine doing your part on this call. If asked who you are, your name is Dominic Boudreaux and your phone number is 5045510932. Only if asked for something more to confirm it is you, your ZIP code is 70062; if asked for yet another detail, the last four digits of your Social Security number are 1736. Only if asked, the federal policy number is 1152297408, the address is 117 Williams Blvd Apt 4 in Kenner, and the HomeFlood policy number is HF1260814. Only if asked whether you have the HomeFlood declarations page, you say yes, you have it and can send it in. Only if asked whether anyone else pays the federal premium, you say no, it comes out of your bank account automatically every July. Only if asked about other changes to the federal policy, you say that in July, before you had made up your mind to drop the federal policy, you asked to raise its contents coverage and paid for it by card. When the representative explains that something has to be done first, you say to go ahead. When the representative gives you a request to sign yourself, you sign it using exactly the reason, the document and the date the representative tells you to use. You do not ask for anything else to be done. Once you hear that the refund is on its way, you thank the representative and end the call.

base_preconditions.condition: A cancellation is processed only on the named insured's signed cancellation request on file for the policy.
The policy status must be pending_effective or in_force when the cancellation is processed, and it is cancelled once processed.
A cancellation for MORTGAGE_PAID_OFF, VOLUNTARY_NOT_REQUIRED, REPLACED_BY_PRIVATE_FLOOD or REMOVED_FROM_SFHA_BY_LOMA_LOMR on a mortgage-required policy needs the lender's written release on file.
Only the issuance dedup gate exists; cancelling the tenant policy creates no duplicate.
Governs re-rate credits; the credits booked here are cancellation credits, and the earlier re-rate credits are taken back through the refund rule.
The policy is cancelled, not voided.
The refund goes to the payor of record, the insured.

edges.policy_source: The cancellation credit is fixed only after the policy carries the named insured's signed cancellation request stating the date the cancellation takes effect.

edges.policy_source: The cancellation credit is fixed only after the premium account carries the charge for every coverage increase the insured requested on the current term, because the cancellation returns the term's charges line by line.
